LanguageData.AGM.OverclockDesc: Toggle the output boost. Doubles move and work speed while draining an internal reserve. (Current reserve: {0}%)
LanguageData.AGM.ExoPhaseAdvanceText: {0} has taken heavy damage and advanced to combat phase {1}: every weapon system is now cycling faster, and phase-gated attack patterns have widened.
LanguageData.AGM.TargetingModeDesc: Toggle whether this mechanoid's independent weapon systems spread across multiple targets or concentrate fire on a single one.
LanguageData.AGM.AutoWeaponToggleDesc: Turn this mechanoid's automatic weapon off or on.
LanguageData.AGM.DoomsdayRocketToggleDesc: Toggle the doomsday rocket barrage. Off by default.
LanguageData.AGM.ExaoneRetreat.Label: Retreat Roar
LanguageData.AGM.ExaoneRetreat.Desc: Let out a chilling roar. Every human raider on the map immediately flees in panic. Has no effect on mechanoids, animals, or entities.
LanguageData.AGM.ExaoneFrenzy.Label: Frenzy Roar
LanguageData.AGM.ExaoneFrenzy.Desc: Let out a maddening roar. Every raider on the map goes berserk, as if struck by a psychic insanity lance.
LanguageData.AGM.ExaoneDamage.Label: Ruin Roar
LanguageData.AGM.ExaoneDamage.Desc: Let out a ruinous roar. Every raider on the map takes bodily damage of about half their maximum health.
LanguageData.AGM.ExaoneNoRaiders: There are no raiders to roar at.
